meta.title: Setup Wizard
meta.description: Review the 12-step onboarding flow used for first-run and new-user setup in Loquor AAC.

hero.title: Setup Wizard
hero.description: The setup wizard standardizes onboarding by guiding teams through language, layout, grammar, voice, and security decisions.

steps.title: Language Selection
steps.purpose: Set language context before all other decisions. Applies immediately so all subsequent steps render in the chosen language.

steps.title: User Profile
steps.purpose: Capture name, avatar, age, diagnosis, and notes for profile identity and care context.

steps.title: Input Mode
steps.purpose: Choose Symbol Grid or Text-only. Selecting Text-only removes symbol-specific steps from the wizard.

steps.title: Grid Mode
steps.purpose: Choose Standard, Activity Boards, or Core-Fringe communication structure.

steps.title: Voice Provider
steps.purpose: Select device speech (offline) or optional ElevenLabs cloud voice provider.

steps.title: Fitzgerald Key
steps.purpose: Enable or disable colour-coded grammar category cues on pictograms.

steps.title: Progressive Vocabulary
steps.purpose: Enable staged vocabulary growth model with readiness checks and ghost slots.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.purpose: Configure theme (Light, Dark, High Contrast, Child-Friendly) and symbol font size.

steps.title: Grid Layout
steps.purpose: Set column count (6-12) and landscape display mode preferences.

steps.title: Smart Grammar
steps.purpose: Configure automatic verb conjugation and long-press inflection picker.

steps.title: PIN Setup
steps.purpose: Protect admin operations with optional 4-6 digit PIN security.

steps.title: Summary
steps.purpose: Review all selections before finalising setup and launching the app.

outcomes.title: Implementation Outcomes
items: Consistent onboarding for caregivers and clinicians
Repeatable setup across new and duplicate user profiles
Faster initial readiness with fewer manual configuration passes
Input mode selection adapts the wizard to symbol or text workflows
